node: AI-disrupted student acquisition, enrollment operations, and admissions conversion infrastructure
summary: Expanded the node universe toward US-listed small/mid-cap education services and infrastructure companies with plausible exposure to a shift from paid search/lead generation toward employer channels, owned advising workflows, compliant admissions conversion, payment/retention infrastructure, and AI-assisted enrollment targeting. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are not pure-play CRM vendors; they are education operators/service providers with embedded employer pipelines, student-success data, admissions processes, or campus payment workflows that may become more valuable if AI search weakens legacy student acquisition funnels.
